join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add pan FOUND THE (_PARAMETER_CAPS_), HAVE YE?
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'pan' added, restricted to subscribers and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!pan working command
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!pan working command
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FOUND THE WORKING COMMAND, HAVE YE?


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command restrict pan everyone
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'pan' restricted to everyone and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!pan working command
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FOUND THE WORKING COMMAND, HAVE YE?


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command restrict pan mods
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'pan' restricted to moderators and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!pan working command
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=moderator :!pan working command
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FOUND THE WORKING COMMAND, HAVE YE?


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command restrict pan owner
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'pan' restricted to broadcasters and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!pan working command
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=moderator :!pan working command
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=broadcaster :!pan working command
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FOUND THE WORKING COMMAND, HAVE YE?

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!pan working command
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FOUND THE WORKING COMMAND, HAVE YE?


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=admin :!command restrict pan admin
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'pan' restricted to admins and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=broadcaster :!pan working command
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!pan working command
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=admin :!pan working command
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FOUND THE WORKING COMMAND, HAVE YE?
